categories.main_business_segments: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the semiconductor equipment precision components sector. Its main product lines include mechanical and electromechanical components (such as chambers, liners, gas distribution plates, and modules) and gas transmission systems (including gas cabinets and pipelines). These products serve semiconductor manufacturing equipment, covering processes like etching, thin film deposition, photolithography, coating/developing, chemical mechanical polishing, and ion implantation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mechanical manufacturing, specialized surface treatment technologies, and welding processes including electron beam welding, laser welding, vacuum brazing, and ultra-clean pipeline welding. It has developed proprietary coating technologies such as dense YO coatings, N/O series films, and Al-F composite films for corrosion resistance and cleanliness. Manufacturing methods include high-precision micro-hole and deep-hole processing, ultra-high surface finish, and one-stop large cavity machining, supported by intelligent manufacturing and modular production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers, including top-tier global semiconductor equipment companies and major Chinese semiconductor equipment firms. The company serves the semiconductor industry chain, particularly focusing on front-end semiconductor manufacturing processes. Its products are used in integrated circuit fabrication, LED, display panels, and photovoltaic equipment manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant revenue from the Chinese mainland (approximately 70% of revenue) and expanding international markets including the United States, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Taiwan. It has production facilities in Shenyang, Nantong, Beijing, and Singapore, with strategic overseas capacity to serve global customers and mitigate trade barriers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fortune Precision operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and assembly of precision components and modules for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. It provides critical parts and integrated gas transmission systems that are essential for semiconductor fabrication equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focused on advanced process equipment components for cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing (7nm and beyond). It prioritizes innovation in surface treatment coatings, precision machining, and gas transmission system integration. Strategic initiatives include intelligent manufacturing, global capacity expansion, vertical integration through acquisitions, and collaboration with leading semiconductor equipment manufacturers to enhance product performance and supply chain autonomy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision components and gas transmission system products to semiconductor equipment manufacturers. The company operates on a build-to-order production model, providing tailored solutions and integrated modules, with pricing based on material costs, process complexity, and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fortune Precision is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the semiconductor equipment precision components market, recognized for its comprehensive manufacturing capabilities and advanced surface treatment technologies. It competes with international suppliers from the US, Japan, and Taiwan but differentiates itself through full-chain manufacturing and strong customer relationships. The company is a core supplier to global semiconductor equipment leaders and benefits from the growing domestic semiconductor equipment market and localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 3.04 billion, representing a 47.14% year-over-year increase, driven by strong semiconductor market demand and domestic localization. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 202.65 million, up 20.13%. The company has shown robust growth with expanding production capacity and improving profitability, supported by increased R&D spending (7.28% of revenue) and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fortune Precision offers high-precision, high-cleanliness, and corrosion-resistant semiconductor equipment components with advanced proprietary coating technologies and integrated gas transmission systems. Its full-chain manufacturing capability, including precision machining, surface treatment, and welding, enables it to deliver high-quality, customized solutions that reduce supply chain complexity and improve customer procurement efficiency. The company’s strategic global footprint and strong R&D partnerships provide competitive advantages in technology leadership and supply chain security.
